1password@nightly.reason: Vendor deployment documentation explicitly identifies this bundle ID; nightly is an update channel of the same Mac app.

abbyy-finereader-pdf.reason: Vendor documentation associates FineReader PDF with this identifier. Homebrew distinguishes the main app from its nested PDF Viewer, supporting exclusion of com.abbyy.FRPDFViewer.

affinity.reason: Homebrew associates this identifier with Affinity's recent documents and application storage; the team-prefixed alternative is explicitly a group container. Inferred without inspecting the app manifest.

airfoil.reason: Homebrew lists this executable bundle ID alongside AirfoilSpeakers for the two installed apps; it corresponds to primary Airfoil.app rather than Airfoil Satellite.

anylist.reason: Homebrew associates this identifier with AnyList's application support and caches, while the recipe-import identifier belongs to a separate extension container. Inferred without inspecting the app manifest.

anytype.reason: Official desktop build configuration sets appId to com.anytype.anytype and productName to Anytype; the .desktop.json candidate is a native-messaging manifest filename.

anytype@alpha.reason: Official alpha-version build configuration explicitly sets this appId for Anytype; Homebrew identifies the artifact as Anytype.app.

anytype@beta.reason: Official desktop build configuration sets this appId across release channels; Homebrew's beta artifact is the same Anytype.app.

aphera.reason: Homebrew metadata associates this identifier with the app's container, caches and preferences, while co.latentco.Aphera.QuickLook identifies its extension. Inferred without direct Info.plist verification.

apparency.reason: The vendor's official download page explicitly lists com.mothersruin.Apparency as the application's Bundle Identifier.

ariax.reason: Homebrew’s supplied metadata associates this identifier with the main app’s container, caches, and HTTP storage; other candidates identify the helper, extension, or app group. Inferred without manifest verification.

audiobook-builder.reason: Homebrew’s supplied metadata uses this identifier for application saved state, caches, and WebKit storage. The team-prefixed alternative identifies a shared app group. Inferred without manifest verification.

baidunetdisk.reason: Homebrew associates this identifier with the primary app’s saved state, cookies, caches, and crash reports; the FinderSync identifier belongs to its extension. Inferred without manifest verification.

base.reason: Homebrew associates Base.app with this cache and preferences identifier; the alternative appears only in help-system caches. Inferred without manifest verification.

batteries.reason: Homebrew’s supplied metadata distinguishes the main app’s cache and preferences identifier from explicitly named helpers, widgets, extensions, and the team-prefixed app group. Inferred without manifest verification.

bezel.reason: Homebrew associates Bezel.app with this identifier across caches, HTTP storage, and preferences; the other candidates identify helper services. Inferred without direct manifest verification.

bitrix24.reason: Homebrew associates Bitrix24.app with this application-script and HTTP-storage identifier; the separate .finder-ext candidate identifies its Finder extension. Inferred without direct manifest verification.

blip.reason: Homebrew links Blip.app to this recent-documents and HTTP-storage identifier, separately listing share and preview extensions and a group container. Inferred without direct manifest verification.

bluesnooze.reason: The official Xcode project explicitly sets PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER to this value in both Debug and Release configurations for the Bluesnooze application target.

box-tools.reason: Box documentation identifies Box Edit as the editing component of Box Tools; Homebrew lists this identifier in uninstall.quit. The primary-app selection is inferred from its role.

brightvpn.reason: The Homebrew cask installs BrightVPN.app and associates brightvpn.com with its primary preferences and caches; the other candidates are explicitly named updater and updater-launcher components.

claude.reason: Homebrew installs Claude.app and lists this quit identifier separately from the .helper identifier. Anthropic’s documentation corroborates the same desktop app domain; the primary bundle association is inferred rather than verified from Info.plist.

docker-desktop.reason: Docker’s official repository shows this value as Docker.app’s CFBundleIdentifier; com.electron.dockerdesktop is a secondary frontend identifier.

forklift.reason: Homebrew’s cask metadata consistently associates this identifier with ForkLift 4 caches, preferences, HTTP storage, and saved state, while ForkLiftMini is a secondary component.

google-chrome.reason: Homebrew installs Google Chrome.app; Chromium’s official macOS documentation explicitly lists com.google.Chrome as Chrome Stable’s bundle ID.

notion.reason: Notion’s official macOS deployment guide uses notion.id as the preference domain for the installed Notion desktop app, matching Homebrew’s quit and app-state metadata.
